analysis.headline: No Overt Data Selling
analysis.quote: Our business is cybersecurity, and everything we do centers around making the world safe for exchanging digital information. This includes keeping our customer and partner information private and secure.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Data Automatically
analysis.quote: We also collect certain information automatically from your devices.

analysis.headline: Uses AI, Details Unclear
analysis.quote: We understand the importance of responsibly using artificial intelligence, including new approaches like generative AI.

analysis.headline: CCTV Monitors Your Presence
analysis.quote: Trend Micro operates a closed-circuit television (CCTV) at our offices globally for security purposes.

analysis.headline: Uses Cookies to Track You
analysis.quote: Trend Micro Incorporated and its group companies collectively use cookies and similar technologies to recognize when you visit our website.

analysis.headline: Lists Your Data Subprocessors
analysis.quote: View a list of Trend Micro’s processors and subprocessors

analysis.headline: Responds to Government Requests
analysis.quote: Trend’s procedure for responding to requests from law enforcement or other government authority.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Globally
analysis.quote: Trend has extensive Technical and Organizational Measures in place, has taken into account the EDPB’s Recommendations, carried out appropriate Transfer International Assessments (TIA’s), and put in place a Governmental Request Policy. All these measures protect any transfer of personal data that may occur from the EEAQ/UK to countries who may not currently have adequacy decisions from the EU in place.

analysis.headline: No Explicit Retention Policy
analysis.quote: How do I request deletion of my personal information? For individual data deletion requests, please visit Individual Rights
